description:
Use this when the user wants the documents an Indian company filed, grouped by type: results, annual reports, investor presentations, call transcripts and recordings, board meeting and AGM papers, ratings. For what was announced and when use get_stock_events.

Returns the documents the company filed with BSE, each with its type, date and link. `days` is 1 to 1825 (default 365). `document_type` filters to one of: results, annual_report, presentation, transcript, recording, board_meeting, agm_egm, insider_takeover, rating, management_change, deal, corporate_action, press_release, investor_meet, compliance, other. `limit` is 1 to 1000 (default 60), newest first: pass a type or fewer `days` when the list is cut. Transcripts and recordings are links only. The `results` type can be incomplete: the figures are in get_financials. A document with an `extraction_id` has already been read: pass that id as `news_id` to get_filing_extract.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query
